limitations: Warm harness status reports oracle checks, not performance eligibility.
First-query-after-build is not cold; separate lifecycle driver measures fresh process.
Whole-harness peak RSS includes corpus, Arrow, oracle and snapshots, not backend-only usage.

Docs1 baseline/candidate pilot runs precede added contract_ok reporting and SQLite failure probes; exact historical harness hash not captured. Query and storage paths unchanged; no exact revision provenance claimed for those pilots.
No complete public relevance/citation/rerank comparison; coherent published snapshot needed and canonical comparator refuses differing package versions.
Nonlocal platform/runtime checks not run; published wheels only.
Lance interruption/reclamation/destination rollback not run after failed warm slice; no adoption authorized.
SQLite cold/three-paired-build cycles not run after Stage1 failure.
